label: GO after a rewarded trial when the agent is about to choose a2, mostly early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1; never after no reward), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (model_act==2 holds 86% of mass; choice logit strongly favours a2). It never fires at D1 or D2. The base condition GO & prev_reward==1 & choosing a2 has recall 0.89 but precision 0.22, because the unit strongly fades over the episode: rate is about 10% of steps in trials 0-19 and near 0 by trials 90-99 (also lower when value is high, >8.1 never). Adding ep_trial<30 raises precision to 0.69. The largest activations are switches to a2 after a rewarded a1 trial (often a rewarded rare transition to S2, i.e. the model-based switch toward a2), so the disjunct prev_action==1 brings back late-episode high-magnitude cases and raises mass recall to 0.78. All terms are observed or the upcoming choice of the agent; there are no future random outcomes. The episode-time dependence looks like a slow drift in the hidden state, not a task variable, so this is partial.
